{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only, as per contract population
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
# No filtering for status or revenue — per contract, all loyal customers are included
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Number of loyal customers (full population): {len(loyal_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {loyal_df['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers (as per contract): {conversion_rate}")"}
